en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large historic square with a monumental fountain in the foreground, decorated with statues of Neptune and other figures. Behind the fountain stands a Romanesque cathedral with a rose window and tall drum-like tower, and to the left are older civic buildings lining the square. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the Fontana del Nettuno in Piazza Vittorio Emanuele III in Trento.
